date.title: Служба национальных парков США · Методы археологического датирования
date.passage: Dating methods table. C-14 dates organic material including bone, tree ring patterns are cross-matched, thermoluminescence measures heat-released light from trapped electrons, and volcanic glass acquires a hydration band. Superposition applies to undisturbed deposits; TPQ is the earliest possible time of deposition.

rc.title: Historic England · Радиоуглеродное датирование
rc.passage: Radiocarbon Dating guidance, measurement and the example of repeated dating of collagen extracted from an inhumation at Mile Oak.

dendro.title: Служба национальных парков США · Дендрохронология в Ацтекских руинах
dendro.passage: Tree cores can be obtained from archaeological beams; tree-ring widths are compared. The Aztec Ruins graph identifies two construction phases at 1111 and 1118 CE.

fired.title: Historic England · Научные методы датирования памятников палеолита
fired.passage: Luminescence dating section: luminescence can date the last heating of stones and flints.

fire.title: Служба национальных парков США · Пожары и археология в горах Хемес
fire.passage: Dome Fire and later studies: obsidian is volcanic glass; forest fire exposure altered its hydration rind, even though geochemical sourcing remained possible.

context.title: Служба национальных парков США · Археологический контекст
context.passage: Provenience and associations help relate an object to its stratigraphic location, other artifacts and ecofacts. Different site formation processes can change the original context.

cut.title: Служба национальных парков США · Принцип пересекающих отношений
cut.passage: Principle of Cross-Cutting Relationships: younger units or structures cut across pre-existing older units or structures. An erosional surface is younger than the rocks it erodes.

heMatrix.title: Historic England · Использование археологических стратиграфических данных
heMatrix.passage: Harris matrix diagrams record the stratigraphic sequence of features and deposits and help support post-excavation analysis.

palyn.title: Historic England · Методы анализа растительных остатков
palyn.passage: Table 5: palynology is analysis of pollen and spores. It reveals vegetation composition, structure, succession and changes. The table also covers phytoliths and macrofossils.

phyto.title: Historic England · Микроскопические остатки растений в археологии
phyto.passage: Discussion of the application of phytoliths, microscopic silica bodies produced in plant tissues, in the study of past plants and environmental changes.

plants.title: Historic England · Археоботаника
plants.passage: Archaeobotany uses macrofossils including grains, seeds and chaff, and also wood, charcoal and microfossils. The page describes identification facilities and the modern reference seed collection.

env.title: Historic England · Археология окружающей среды
env.passage: Technical guidance includes study of archaeological animal bones and teeth and geoarchaeology as the application of earth science to the archaeological record.

sher.title: Historic England · Обугленные растительные остатки замка Шерборн
sher.passage: Study of excavated charred remains. Cereal grains and weed seeds dominate the assemblage, interpreted as possible kitchen waste.

archTime.title: Служба национальных парков США · Как археологи узнают возраст памятника
archTime.passage: Explains types of evidence and comparisons, depositional stratigraphy, dates of artifacts as limits on deposition and tree-ring dating.

note: The original unsupported 017 claim of a single depositional event remains in INITIAL and has been removed from CURRENT.
